userStories.title: Fix hardcoded stale default model state
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the defaultModel state initializer in DisplaySection to use 'claude-sonnet-4-6' so that the component no longer references the removed Sonnet 4.5 model.

No other hardcoded claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 references remain in ProviderSettingsTab.tsx
npx tsc --noEmit passes with no new errors
npm run lint passes

userStories.title: Replace Default Model native select with ModelSearchSelect
userStories.description: As a user, I want the Default Model selector to use the searchable ModelSearchSelect dropdown so I can find models by typing instead of scrolling a long native select.
acceptanceCriteria: The Default Model <select> element (~line 1907 in ProviderSettingsTab.tsx) is replaced with <ModelSearchSelect>
models array is mapped to ModelOption[] shape (id, label, provider, costPer1kInput, costPer1kOutput, contextWindow, speedTier, costTier, recommended) for the ModelSearchSelect props
onChange prop calls setDefaultModel(modelId)
value prop is wired to the defaultModel state string
defaultModelId prop is passed as null
The old <option> map is fully removed — no dead code remains
Trigger button shows: model label, cost/1K badge, context window text
npx tsc --noEmit passes, npm run lint passes
Settings > Display tab loads and the Default Model dropdown opens, searches, and selects correctly in the browser

userStories.title: Replace Workspace Model Override native select with ModelSearchSelect
userStories.description: As a user, I want the Workspace Model Override selector to use ModelSearchSelect consistently with the Default Model selector so both dropdowns have the same search-as-you-type UX.
acceptanceCriteria: The Workspace Override <select> (~line 1933 in ProviderSettingsTab.tsx) is replaced with <ModelSearchSelect>

When workspaceModel is null, value prop is passed as empty string '' and ModelSearchSelect shows a 'Use global default (ModelName)' placeholder — add this as a synthetic first option or handle empty value in ModelSearchSelect
onChange calls setWorkspaceModel(modelId) for non-empty selections and setWorkspaceModel(null) when empty string is selected
The Save button beside the dropdown is preserved and unchanged
ModelSearchSelect accepts an optional disabled boolean prop; when disabled={savingWorkspace} the trigger button is non-interactive with opacity-50
Add disabled prop to ModelSearchSelect component interface if it doesn't exist
npx tsc --noEmit passes, npm run lint passes
Workspace Override dropdown opens, searches, selects, and saves correctly in the browser

userStories.title: Add search bar and provider filter chips to Available Models catalog
userStories.description: As a user, I want to search and filter the Available Models catalog so I can find relevant models without scrolling through hundreds of cards.
acceptanceCriteria: A search bar (text input with Search icon from lucide-react) renders at the top of the Available Models section in DisplaySection
Typing in the search bar filters rendered ModelCard components in real-time by label, provider, and model ID (case-insensitive)

A provider filter chips row renders below the search bar: 'All' chip first, then one chip per distinct provider derived dynamically from the models array (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, Ollama)
Provider chips are sorted by descending model count (most models first)
Active chip styled: bg-accent/10 border-accent text-accent; inactive: border-border text-muted hover:text-[var(--text)]
Selecting a provider chip filters the catalog to that provider only; clicking 'All' resets
Search text and provider chip filter compose with AND logic (text search within the selected provider)
A model count label ('N models') appears at the right end of the search bar row, reflecting the current filtered count
All filter state (searchText, activeProvider) lives as local useState inside DisplaySection — no new hooks or context
npx tsc --noEmit passes, npm run lint passes
Verify in browser: typing 'gpt' with All provider shows only GPT models; selecting Anthropic chip hides all non-Anthropic cards

userStories.title: Add cost tier and speed filter pills to model catalog
userStories.description: As a user, I want to further narrow the model catalog by cost tier and speed so I can quickly find e.g. free fast models.
acceptanceCriteria: A second filter row renders below the provider chips with two pill groups: Cost (All | Free | Low | Medium | High | Premium) and Speed (All | Fast | Medium | Slow)
Each group's 'All' option is selected by default
Active pill uses same accent highlight as provider chips
All four filters (search text + provider + cost tier + speed tier) compose with AND logic

When no ModelCards match all active filters, show an empty state message: 'No models match your filters' with a 'Clear filters' text button that resets searchText, activeProvider, activeCostTier, and activeSpeedTier to their defaults
Filter state resets to defaults when DisplaySection unmounts and remounts
npx tsc --noEmit passes, npm run lint passes
Verify in browser: selecting Free + Fast pills shows only free fast models; Clear filters restores full list

userStories.title: Collapse OpenRouter section by default with count badge and expand toggle
userStories.description: As a user, I want the OpenRouter provider section to be collapsed by default so the page isn't dominated by 100+ model cards, with a clear expand affordance when I need to browse them.
acceptanceCriteria: Provider sections in DisplaySection use a collapsed: Set<string> state initialized as new Set(['OpenRouter']) — OpenRouter starts collapsed, all others start expanded
Each provider section header row is clickable and toggles its entry in the collapsed Set
Collapsed section header shows: provider name label + model count badge (e.g. '142 models' in text-muted) + ChevronRight icon
Expanded section header shows: provider name label + ChevronDown icon (no count badge needed when expanded)
Model cards for a provider are only rendered when that provider is NOT in the collapsed Set

When a search text or provider chip filter is active that produces OpenRouter results, remove 'OpenRouter' from the collapsed Set so matches are visible (useEffect watching searchText + activeProvider)
On initial load, if the effectiveModel (workspaceModel ?? defaultModel) belongs to OpenRouter, remove 'OpenRouter' from collapsed Set so the selected card is visible
Collapse state resets (OpenRouter collapsed again) when DisplaySection unmounts
npx tsc --noEmit passes, npm run lint passes
Verify in browser: page loads with OpenRouter collapsed; clicking header expands it; searching 'gpt-5' auto-expands OpenRouter

userStories.title: Limit OpenRouter expanded view to 30 models with Show More button
userStories.description: As a user, I want the expanded OpenRouter section to initially show only 30 models with a Show More button so the DOM stays fast even when fully expanded.
acceptanceCriteria: A showAllOpenRouter: boolean state (default false) is added to DisplaySection; it resets to false when OpenRouter is collapsed
When OpenRouter is expanded and showAllOpenRouter is false and no search text is active, only the first 30 OpenRouter models are rendered as ModelCards
A 'Show more (N remaining)' button appears below the 30 cards — clicking it sets showAllOpenRouter to true, rendering all OpenRouter models
When search text is active, all matching OpenRouter models are shown regardless of showAllOpenRouter (search implies intent)

The currently selected OpenRouter model (if any) is always rendered even if it falls outside the first 30 — hoist it to the top of the OpenRouter section with a subtle 'Selected' separator line above the remaining cards
showAllOpenRouter resets to false when the OpenRouter section is collapsed
npx tsc --noEmit passes, npm run lint passes
Verify in browser: expand OpenRouter, see 30 cards + 'Show more (N remaining)' button; click it to reveal all; collapse and re-expand resets to 30
